title: Budget settlement reconciliation
description: Objective: settle active reservations with the honest measurement records from task-5ee5b801127a4536a6e770abc6e83e9e while preserving the hierarchical ledger from task-a5def097bcb7495e935204bd845160b4. Deliverable: packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-settlement.ts, its one-line .js bridge, and focused tests for exact settlement/refund, partial or unknown quarantine, never-started proof, conservative write-off, explicit overrun, reconciliation, and legal account closure. NOT in scope: provider adapters, billing APIs, policy decisions after unknown liability, supersession funding, persistence, or package-root export. Hard dependencies: tasks task-a5def097bcb7495e935204bd845160b4, task-318c0732094c417f96932b5c83e7388b, and task-5ee5b801127a4536a6e770abc6e83e9e must be DONE unchanged. Owned paths: budget-settlement.ts, budget-settlement.js, budget-settlement.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-settlement.test.ts.
definitionOfDone: A complete correlated measurement commits exact use, refunds only the proven remainder, and is duplicate-safe; measured use above reservation creates explicit overrun liability and OVERDRAWN state without negative buckets or sibling funding.
PARTIAL commits only its proven lower bound and quarantines the unresolved remainder; UNKNOWN quarantines the reservation and never writes zero committed usage.
Proof that an effect never started refunds every refundable reservation while any already-committed attempt.count remains committed.

Conservative settlement commits the full held reservation as CONSERVATIVE_WRITE_OFF; when no enforceable upper bound existed it also records persistent UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_LIABILITY and closes only as CLOSED_WITH_UNKNOWN_LIABILITY.
No account closes with RESERVED or QUARANTINED units; stale, out-of-order, conflicting, or illegal reconciliation has zero effect with frozen deterministic issues.
Both TypeScript files are <=250 physical lines, the bridge is one exact re-export line, and the focused verification command exits 0.
taskRails: Do not modify predecessor modules/tests; compose only their public internal-budget exports.
The four design quarantine exits are closed; no generic refund/forgive path and no conversion of unknown external liability to exact spend.
Production and test TypeScript files must each be <=250 physical lines; stage only the three explicit owned paths.
